name: ahmed-factory-system
description: Ahmed Corrugation Machines - billing, ledger, stock. Working prototype.

scripts.reset:
node -e "const{createClient}=require('@libsql/client');const fs=require('fs');const path=require('path');const envPath=path.join(__dirname,'.env.local');if(fs.existsSync(envPath)){for(const l of fs.readFileSync(envPath,'utf8').split('
')){const t=l.trim();if(!t||t.startsWith('#'))continue;const e=t.indexOf('=');if(e===-1)continue;const k=t.slice(0,e);if(!process.env[k])process.env[k]=t.slice(e+1);}}const url=process.env.TURSO_DATABASE_URL||'file:'+path.join(__dirname,'data','factory.db');const db=createClient({url,authToken:process.env.TURSO_AUTH_TOKEN||undefined});(async()=>{const tables=['data_issues','activity_log','counters','expenses','ledger_entries','bill_lines','bills','stock_movements','stock_items','customers','item_types'];for(const t of tables){try{await db.execute({sql:'DELETE FROM '+t,args:[]})}catch(e){}}db.close();console.log('Cleared all tables — run npm run seed to repopulate.');})()"
